name: TCS
tagline: Global IT services, consulting, and business solutions company.
overview: TCS is one of India’s largest IT services companies. It is known for its large campus hiring programs, coding assessments, and structured interview rounds.
highlights: Strong campus hiring culture with aptitude and coding rounds
Focus on communication, core CS fundamentals, and problem-solving
Frequently asks practical questions on DBMS, OOPs, OS, and basics of programming
targetTopics: OOPs concepts in Java or C++
notes: Practice a few aptitude mocks before interviews to improve speed and confidence.
Keep your answers structured and simple in technical and HR rounds.
Review common output-based questions, especially around loops, pointers, inheritance, and SQL joins.

sections.heading: Common interview pattern
sections.content: Typical TCS hiring process includes an aptitude or NQT test, communication screening, technical interview, and HR round. Students are often expected to be comfortable with coding concepts, logical reasoning, and basics of OOPs and DBMS.

sections.heading: How to prepare
sections.content: Focus on core CS fundamentals, basic programming, communication, and coding confidence. Practice aptitude questions, basic output-based questions, and common interview answers using a simple and clear structure.

questions.question: What are the most important topics for TCS preparation?
questions.answer: Aptitude, logical reasoning, DBMS, OOPs, OS, and basic programming fundamentals are the most common areas.

questions.question: How should I prepare for the communication round?
questions.answer: Practice self-introduction, strengths, hobbies, academic projects, and basic HR questions with confident and concise answers.
